capability: Batch current governance record index transport without changing admission
searchEvidence: Owner requested repository architecture optimization. Measured baseline validator on ac261ced: cProfile 212.908 seconds, governance 179.642 seconds, subprocess.run 2866 calls, _git_index_blob 310 calls / 56.596 seconds.
Existing _git_index_blob owns per-path stage/mode/intent-to-add checks; _read_git_blob_batch owns cat-file framing. Existing history batching remains unchanged.
Twenty git rev-parse calls measured 1.143 seconds with pipes versus 1.145 seconds with temporary files: rejected I/O transport substitution as ineffective.
terminalContract: Invocation-local snapshot carries raw entries, HEAD/staged paths and blobs to the existing per-path admission owner. Current record paths use bounded Git transport calls; checkpoint and external attestation callers remain unchanged. No persistent cache, validation bypass, firmware or release contract changes.

designReview.evidence: Independent R2 PASS for transport batching only. Preserve one per-path semantic owner and existing blob parser. Test single/batch parity for normal/new/empty/missing/intent-to-add/conflict/mode/path cases, command and protocol failures, same-blob different paths, fresh snapshots and bounded subprocess count. Keep all existing governance negatives.
